text:
Sara: FYI a customer (acct 4321) flagged a big invoice bump yesterday; dashboard shows normal token usage but invoice +$900. Suspect streaming chunk merge after reconnect. Details below.

Liam: Can you paste the invoice line + sample request ids?

Sara: Invoice lines: "streaming.tokens: 9,120" vs dashboard says ~2,300 for same day. Customer session id: sess_9Xc3. Attached ledger rows: ledger_id 98765, 98766 show merged final frames.

Kofi: I saw similar where client reconnects and server emits "final" twice when last chunk arrives and during merge. Need SSE frames capture.

Sara: Customer provided SSE capture. Pasting sanitized frames:
```
data: {"event":"chunk","tokens":120}
data: {"event":"chunk","tokens":80}
// client disconnect, reconnect
data: {"event":"chunk","tokens":300}
data: {"event":"final","tokens":150}
```

Ana: Hmm looks like server replays buffered chunks and then emits final; if our metering counts both pre-merge tokens and merged final, double-count can happen.

Liam: Do we dedupe by chunk id? We currently dedupe only by final flag within same connection. Reconnect can create new chunk ids.

Sara: Customer SDK is basic fetch SSE; they cancel stream on UI close which can cause client re-open and server side resume leading to both partial and final being logged.

billing-bot: Automated check shows ledger gap: subtotal missing a credit for duplicate final, not deduped. Tagging billing team.

Kofi: Repro plan: run a local server with streaming model, simulate client abort + reconnect within 2s, monitor metering events. I can run with `--enable-merge-debug` to log token counting.

Liam: Quick mitigation: mark suspect invoices as disputed until we patch. Also add a short-term ledger reconciliation to collapse proximate final events with same session id.

Sara: Customer asked for interim credit. I'll offer a temporary refund pending investigation. Need exact date and invoice id, sending now.

Ana: For fix: add server-side merge that subtracts tokens from overlapping prefix if final contains same prefix tokens. Also add an idempotency token in SSE handshake.

Kofi: I'll open an eng bug and attach reproducer. Adding logs and snippet. :+1:

Sara: Thanks all. I'll DM updates to the customer. :raised_hands:
